source: Arc for Firefox welcome page miniature sidebar (welcome/welcome.html + welcome.css) — our own UI, no search
brief: Eight 3-second, loop-safe segments, one per feature. Left: the miniature Arc sidebar from the welcome page; right: feature name + one line + shortcut. Each segment starts and ends in the same rest state so each 3s slice loops cleanly as a README GIF. Motion answers the feature: favorites pop in, space tint cycles, folder opens, command bar types, address suggestions drop, sidebar slides away, row splits in two, extension tiles light up.
